products.title: How Anyone Can Make $$$$ on Pinterest
products.subtitle: A practical playbook for turning Pinterest traffic into income.
products.description:
Pinterest is a visual search engine. What do we do when we need reference or aesthetic inspo for literally anything ?  We open Pinterest for one inspo pic and somehow end up scrolling for 2 hours. 
 And that's how Pinterest gets you. You came for one picture, discovered 50 other things, and now you're clicking links to products you didn't even know existed. Well, that little rabbit hole? That's exactly how we're gonna make money after this tutorial.

products.title: 100-DAYS EBOOK EARNINGS
products.subtitle: From Your First Ebook to Your First Digital Sales
products.description:
What happens when you give yourself 100 days to turn your ideas into digital products and start selling them online?

This ebook follows a 100-day challenge focused on creating, launching and promoting ebooks, building an online storefront, experimenting with marketing strategies and learning how to attract potential buyers.

Whether you're starting with zero experience or looking for a new online income stream, this challenge is about taking action, testing ideas, learning from results and building something of your own, one day at a time.
